text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on McCowan Road, City Council approval of this report is required. This report recommends prohibiting westbound left turns at the north driveway of 2201 McCowan Road in accordance with the conditions of the development agreement.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit westbound left turns at all times at McCowan Road and the private access at 2201 McCowan Road, located on the east side of McCowan Road, 100 metres north of Huntingwood Drive/Middlefield Road.
